description: Free. Use before onboarding or paying a supplier that has a website: reads https://<domain>/.well-known/supplier.json (spec factline.dev/supplier-json), checks its VAT number in VIES and company number in the register against the name, and with iban says whether that IBAN is one of the supplier's own hashed accounts. Returns verified, review, invalid_card or no_card. Input: domain, optional iban.

iban.description: IBAN from an invoice, to match against the card

name: supplier_card_verify
title: Verify a supplier's supplier.json card (free)
